g.text: NUDGE • PHASE 3
Make the evidence understandable
Research synthesis · expected benefits are hypotheses, not measured retention
Easy to answer, easy to skip
Large equal answer targets, visible
neutral/skip choices, and context before any
unfamiliar comparison.
One task, details on request
Keep the question prominent; open meanings,
criteria and source answers through labeled
controls.
No personality from one tap
A surprising answer can mean humor, context
or time pressure. Show a limited reflection
and let the person correct it.
Curiosity without pressure
Question variety and a useful ending; no
guilt streaks, fake social proof, random
unlocks or forced disclosure.
Design specification • Proposals and verification boundaries • Not an app screenshot
